morning2_start.name: Me
morning2_start.text: *Day two. The uniform feels a bit more comfortable than yesterday. Am I adapting fast, or just giving up fast?*

morning2_start_2.name: Me
morning2_start_2.text: *The moment I open the classroom door — something slams into my back.*

morning2_dain_3.name: Dain
morning2_dain_3.text: Haha, from that?! You need to work out more!

morning2_dain_4.name: {name}
morning2_dain_4.text: Isn't it a bit early for this much energy?

morning2_dain_5.name: Dain
morning2_dain_5.text: This is normal! You're the one running low!

morning2_dain_6.name: Me
morning2_dain_6.text: *If there's a world where this volume at 8 AM is normal, Dain would be its president.*

morning2_note_1.name: Me
morning2_note_1.text: *I'm about to sit down when — I spot a folded note on my desk.*

morning2_note_2.name: Me
morning2_note_2.text: *'Come to the library annex at lunch. — Yuna'*

morning2_note_3.name: Me
morning2_note_3.text: *Same neat handwriting as yesterday. Short. And the location is specific. — The library 'annex'? That's a different place from yesterday.*

morning2_seo_1.name: Me
morning2_seo_1.text: *I'm about to pocket the note when — a familiar voice from the hallway.*

morning2_seo_3.name: Me
morning2_seo_3.text: *Seoyeon passes through the hallway, glancing into the classroom. Her gaze locks precisely onto me.*

morning2_seo_4.name: {name}
morning2_seo_4.text: The student council president comes all the way to the classroom to say hi?

morning2_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_5.text: I was just passing by. — Have a fun day today too.

morning2_minsu_1.name: Me
morning2_minsu_1.text: *She didn't stop walking. But her eyes were definitely on me.*

morning2_minsu_2.name: Me
morning2_minsu_2.text: *Minsu turns around from the seat in front of me.*

morning2_minsu_3.name: Minsu
morning2_minsu_3.text: Dude, two days as a transfer student and the student council president comes to greet you? I've been here a year and she won't even make eye contact.

morning2_dain_claim_2.name: Minsu
morning2_dain_claim_2.text: ...That's true, but that's not the point.

morning2_dain_claim_4.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_4.text: Is the president interested in our transfer student too?

morning2_dain_claim_6.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_6.text: I found you first, so you're our transfer student! Dibs! I called dibs!

morning2_break_1.name: Me
morning2_break_1.text: *Can you call dibs on a person? — But somehow I can't be bothered to argue.*

morning2_seo_dust_1.name: Me
morning2_seo_dust_1.text: *Break after first period. I pass Seoyeon in the hallway. She stops. Looks at my shoulder.*

morning2_seo_dust_3.name: Me
morning2_seo_dust_3.text: *Seoyeon's hand reaches toward my shoulder. She brushes something off. Naturally. Too naturally.*

morning2_seo_dust_4.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_4.text: You had something on your clothes.

morning2_dain_react_1.name: Me
morning2_dain_react_1.text: *My heart skipped a beat. — Probably not because of the dust.*

morning2_dain_react_2.name: Me
morning2_dain_react_2.text: *Seoyeon walks away like nothing happened. Dain's voice comes from behind.*

morning2_dain_react_3.name: Dain
morning2_dain_react_3.text: Hey! What was that?! Did she just touch your shoulder?!

morning2_dain_react_6.name: Me
morning2_dain_react_6.text: *There probably was. Maybe. — But I don't think that's the point.*

morning2_haeun_1.name: Me
morning2_haeun_1.text: *In the hallway where Seoyeon disappeared — a girl wearing a student council bracelet approaches.*

morning2_haeun_2.name: Haeun
morning2_haeun_2.text: Um, you're the transfer student, right? I'm Haeun, the student council vice president.

morning2_haeun_4.name: Haeun
morning2_haeun_4.text: The president... I mean, Seoyeon sunbae seems a bit different lately.

morning2_haeun_6.name: Haeun
morning2_haeun_6.text: She's not usually like that. Approaching another student first... I've watched her for a year and this is the first time.

morning2_haeun_7.name: Me
morning2_haeun_7.text: *Haeun gives a slight bow and leaves.*

morning2_end.name: Me
morning2_end.text: *Someone who never once approached anyone first in a whole year — came to me first? What does that mean?*

hidden_homeroom_d2_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_1.text: Oh, {name}. Come to the faculty office for a sec.

hidden_homeroom_d2_2.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d2_2.text: *She says it's administrative. She always wraps her interest in official business.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3.text: Looked at your old transcript. Your Korean grades were solid. You like reading?

hidden_homeroom_d2_4.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d2_4.text: I like reading. — Writing, not so much.

hidden_homeroom_d2_6.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d2_6.text: *The drawer. Did he just glance at it? — Through the crack I can see a stack of papers. Looks like manuscript pages.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_7.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_7.text: How's the adjustment? Better than yesterday?

hidden_homeroom_d2_8.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8.text: Dain's loud, right? — She's always like that. Not a bad kid though. More the type you worry about.

hidden_homeroom_d2_10.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_10.text: Well, teachers worrying about students is just part of the job. Strictly professional.

hidden_homeroom_d2_11.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_11.text: ...I really shouldn't be doing this. Giving the transfer student special treatment — the others would talk.

hidden_homeroom_d2_12.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d2_12.text: *Leaving the faculty office — I can't stop thinking about those papers in the drawer.*
